native_primary: proposed gpt-6.1-sol; exact capability must be qualified
native_worker: proposed gpt-6-luna; same source subscription required
hypothesis: Cheaper-model routing using similar typed subtasks, recency, verified model-specific prior execution, and applicable grounded guidance improves the parent-plus-worker cost-quality frontier.

similarity.implementation: 0.40 subtask-goal token-set cosine + 0.25 typed-subtask match + 0.20 constraint-tag Jaccard + 0.15 action-set Jaccard; mismatched type/granularity excluded before scoring
similarity.parent_deduplication: one observation per earlier task; relevant failure dominates correlated successes

recency.age_anchor: verified execution/check timestamp, not import or publication time
recency.estimate: (1 + weighted_successes) / (2 + weighted_support); descriptive, not calibrated probability
recency.worker_packet_control: Fixed similarity order/byte budget across evidence-based arms; v1 changes age admission, not simultaneous worker prompt ordering.

age_variation_gate.missing_variation: Report recency question unidentifiable; do not force an improvement.

recency.secondary_control: Similarity-only comparator selected on development data for matched cheap coverage/cost; test selections remain frozen.

availability: qualified same-account unexpired capability receipt, required tools, strictly lower relative cost under one frozen rate scenario
fallback: return needs_parent; no automatic Sol invocation

native_stages.launch_policy: Each stage needs its own positive finite budgets and immutable source/model/evaluator/reservation freeze; task counts are proposed, not automatically launched.

retrospective_replay.mode: exploratory leave-one-task-out; all other historical evidence available as of replay time
retrospective_replay.exposure: All 11 original tasks/results are previously exposed; no new holdout or prospective grade-publication chronology is claimed.
retrospective_replay.age_proxy: native completion timestamps; actual historical grade publication time is not inferred
retrospective_replay.availability: simulated same-source capability and relative cost ordering only; cannot authorize native execution
retrospective_replay.cost: sum selected historical execution scenario costs; excludes unobserved new parent/delegation/lookup overhead
retrospective_replay.inference: policy diagnostic only; not evidence of live subtask delegation savings or recency superiority
retrospective_replay.evidence_profile: whole_task_proxy; allowed only with explicit simulation-no-native-source-binding context; cannot enable native execution

supersedes: protocol.json for new native subtask evidence; prior retrospective results remain under their original profile

evidence_admission.granularity: subtask; parent task similarity alone is insufficient
evidence_admission.outcome_target: public_integrated_completion, verified through owned checks; not model self-report or lifecycle completion
evidence_admission.executor_attribution: Record model and observed executor_model must both match the selected cheaper model.
evidence_admission.history_support: Only none/retrieved_guidance are competence evidence. Expert/human/unknown assistance does not establish autonomous cheaper-model success.
evidence_admission.independent_success: Relevant integrated successes without retrieved guidance can support a route without a procedure packet.
evidence_admission.guided_success: Requires versioned guidance_used_ids and a retained guidance_context_ref; exposure is recorded, not claimed causal use. Current matching guidance must be eligible and fit in the worker packet.
evidence_admission.teacher_examples: Verified successful teacher procedures may ground the student. They contribute zero student competence observations.
evidence_admission.failures: Retain attributable failures, including guided failures whose old guidance is unavailable; do not erase negative evidence.
evidence_admission.grounding_compatibility: Preconditions must be present in declared constraints; source executor, verification link, source scope and version must be supported. Preserve source assistance provenance.
evidence_admission.budget: Guided successes do not unlock a route if their required versioned guidance cannot fit in the packet.

mechanism_comparison.mode: separate optional development replay, not a production routing bypass
conditions: same Luna subtask/checkpoint with grounded procedure
same Luna subtask/checkpoint with guidance masked
mechanism_comparison.controls: Hold contract, model, checkpoint, public checks and resource limits fixed. New attempt IDs and full costs; never retry uncertain calls.
mechanism_comparison.purpose: Separate the benefit of guidance from the admission decision. Do not infer benefit from citing an experience ID.
mechanism_comparison.cold_start: Teacher-only guidance may be exercised in the explicitly bounded always-cheap qualification/development arm; default evidence router abstains until student competence is observed.
mechanism_comparison.implementation_status: specification; native paired mechanism qualification not run
